rows.grounds: compound: lalāṭa (forehead) + varṇa (syllable) + rāśi (mass) + stha (situated); describes lakṣaṃ
object of the action expressed by kṛtya
gerund indicating completed performance of repetition
compound vocative: sura (god) + arcita (worshipped); address to the practitioner

items.question: What specific mantra repetition at the forehead is prescribed for the god-worshipped practitioner?
premises: The practitioner is addressed as worshipped by the gods.
A hundred-thousand repetitions are to be performed.
The repetition is situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
items.inference: The god-worshipped practitioner must perform a hundred-thousand repetitions focused on the syllable-mass located at the forehead.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the forehead syllable-mass is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O you worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead...
